name: The Revolutionary's Captive
source:
You awaken in a carriage - wrists bound and trust broken.

Your kingdom is forfeit.

[From [url=https://naoimh-murchan.itch.io/the-revolutionarys-captive]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你在颠簸的马车厢里醒来——双腕被紧紧反绑，昔日的信任早已支离破碎。

你的王国已然覆灭。

[摘自[url=https://naoimh-murchan.itch.io/the-revolutionarys-captive]itch.io[/url]]
